summary:
艾伯維EPS小幅低於預期，但營收年增逾12%顯示Skyrizi與Rinvoq成功接棒Humira。
• EPS 2.65美元，略低於預期2.67美元，差距僅0.77%
• 營收150.0億美元，年增12.43%，免疫新藥成長抵銷Humira專利懸崖
• Skyrizi與Rinvoq雙引擎持續放量，支撑營收成長
• 營收年增表現優於EPS，反映成長投資與費用配置
ai_view:
訊號中性偏正：EPS微幅未達標但差距極小，營收年增逾12%才是重點，證明Skyrizi/Rinvoq已成功接棒。短期股價或因EPS小miss承壓，但成長故事完整。中期關鍵在新藥能否持續超越Humira流失、以及神經與腫瘤管線進展。追蹤指標：Skyrizi/Rinvoq營收與指引、Humira侵蝕速度、毛利率與研發產出，以及108倍高估值的支撑性。

需留意：本益比108倍極高，估值對任何成長放緩極為敏感；Humira生物相似藥侵蝕仍將持續一段時間；新藥定價與支付方議價壓力、產品線集中風險

summary_en:
AbbVie narrowly missed EPS, yet 12%+ revenue growth shows Skyrizi and Rinvoq offsetting Humira's decline.
• EPS of $2.65 slightly missed the $2.67 estimate by 0.77%
• Revenue of $15.00B grew 12.43%, with new immunology drugs offsetting Humira's patent cliff
• Skyrizi and Rinvoq remain dual growth engines driving the top line
• Revenue growth outpaced EPS, reflecting growth investment and expense allocation

ai_view_en:
Signal is neutral-to-positive: the EPS miss is tiny, and the 12%+ revenue growth is the real story, confirming Skyrizi/Rinvoq have taken the baton. Near-term the stock may face mild pressure on the EPS miss, but the growth narrative is intact. Mid-term hinges on whether new drugs keep outrunning Humira erosion and on neuro/oncology pipeline progress. Track: Skyrizi/Rinvoq sales and guidance, Humira erosion pace, gross margin and R&D output, and support for the 108x multiple.

Watch：A 108x P/E is extremely high, leaving valuation very sensitive to any slowdown; Humira biosimilar erosion will continue for some time; Drug-pricing and payer-negotiation pressure, plus pipeline concentration risk
beat_or_miss: 低於預期 / EPS小幅低於預期0.77%，惟營收年增12.43%反映新藥動能強。
